{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(sales.head())

# Check for 'completed' status
print('\nStatus value counts:')
print(sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check revenue dtype and example values
print('\nRevenue dtype:', sales['revenue'].dtype)
print('\nSample revenue values:')
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for QA orders
print('\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):')
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print('\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:', (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
